scope: One bounded visible south Cervantes frontage near Elena. No internal patio partitions, patio floors, inferred enclosure returns or building-footprint changes. Concealed eastern continuation is unasserted.
trust: Photographs support the white lane-side wall, closed curved-coping timber door and cane-roofed pergola, south of Cervantes east of Elena. Plan positions are estimated against the georeferenced Esri aerial, checked street axis and unchanged registry frontage 6265601UF1366N_part1 (roughly 1-2 m uncertainty); heights and dimensions are estimates. Camera pins locate the north-row roof, not these patios.
